text: The Direct Investment Committee recommends an investment of up to $1,000,000 in a Second Lien Loan Facility. Due diligence demonstrates strong alignment with TAF’s mandate and appropriate risk-adjusted return. The allocation complies with TAF’s investment policy and target portfolio.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved an investment of up to $1,000,000, subject to the terms and conditions outlined by the Direct Investment Committee at its meeting on July 11, 2023, as set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 12, 2023) from the Vice President, Impact Investing. 2. Directed Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s Vice President, Impact Investing to confirm satisfactory final due diligence has been completed by PaceZero. 3. Directed Toronto Atmospheric Fund's Vice President, Impact Investing to implement the investment to the satisfaction of Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s Solicitor. 4. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 12, 2023) from the Vice President, Impact Investing remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains commercial and financial information, supplied in confidence to the Toronto Atmospheric Fund,…
